implementationScope: Export transition function cancelReloadOnPostureTransition(currentState: WeaponActionState, currentPosture: CharacterPosture): WeaponActionState
Export transition function cancelReloadOnStun(currentState: WeaponActionState, isStunned: boolean): WeaponActionState
Validate currentState.action using existing WeaponAction validation; if currentState.action !== RELOADING, throw Error as an API precondition contract

In cancelReloadOnPostureTransition: validate currentPosture; if currentPosture !== TRANSITIONING_TO_EXPOSED, return existing currentState unchanged (no-op implementation choice); if currentPosture === TRANSITIONING_TO_EXPOSED, return new WeaponActionState with READY via createWeaponActionState(READY)

In cancelReloadOnStun: validate isStunned; if isStunned === false, return existing currentState unchanged (no-op implementation choice); if isStunned === true, return new WeaponActionState with READY via createWeaponActionState(READY)

Record explicit authority boundary: READY after reload cancellation denotes strictly that Weapon Action is no longer FIRING or RELOADING; does not imply firing permission, ammo availability, global actionability, absence of STUN, or satisfaction of posture prerequisites

Human Decision 1: Two trigger-specific Domain transition functions (cancelReloadOnPostureTransition, cancelReloadOnStun).
Human Decision 2: Active reload precondition. If currentState.action !== RELOADING, throw Error. This is an API precondition / caller-contract decision, not a new canonical gameplay semantic.
Human Decision 3: Inapplicable trigger behavior when RELOADING returns existing currentState unchanged as an implementation/API behavior, not canonical gameplay semantics.
Human Decision 4: Cancellation produces a new WeaponActionState via createWeaponActionState(READY); zero in-place mutation, zero singletons.
Semantic Authority: Canonical reload cancellation semantics established in T-018 / GS-004 §2.

Authority Boundary: READY after reload cancellation denotes strictly that Weapon Action is no longer FIRING or RELOADING. READY does NOT imply firing permission, ammunition availability, global actionability, absence of STUN, or satisfaction of posture prerequisites.
